title: Optimal allocation of a limited prepaid-electricity bridge budget
checked_scope: Heterogeneous initially liquidity-constrained households under fixed prepaid tariffs and the source's repayable bridge technology.
significance: Solves the aggregate bridge allocation with a common shadow price, gives exact marginal-benefit ranking and a concave budget-value frontier while preserving repayment and generation-cost accounting.
